open_flags: The repository's `environments` folder could not be opened from the assistant's side (GitHub does not allow automated readers there), so a folder-specific licence note could not be ruled out. Open https://github.com/BabylonJS/Assets/tree/master/environments once in a browser to confirm there is none.
The shipped file was not compared byte for byte with the one on the asset server: that server is not reachable from the assistant's workspaces.

The npm package @babylonjs/assets (a six-file subset that does not contain this file) is marked Apache-2.0, and a Babylon.js team member wrote in 2020 that playground textures are 'under Apache2 as well'. Both licences allow this use; the credit on the page meets the stricter one.
